offering_description.value: Owns and operates SeaWorld, Busch Gardens, Sesame Place and water parks, selling admission tickets, annual passes, food, merchandise and lodging to leisure visitors. Parks combine animal exhibits, rides and shows. Guests visit the parks in person, with sales made online and at the gate.

primary_products.value: theme park admission tickets; annual passes; food and beverages; retail merchandise

primary_services.value: theme park and water park operation; animal exhibits and entertainment shows; resort lodging and camping; sponsorship and group events

customer_segment.value: B2C: families and individual leisure visitors, tourists and pass members; B2B: group sales, corporate events, sponsors and schools

end_markets.value: theme parks; leisure and entertainment; tourism; family travel

revenue_model.value: product sales: admission tickets, annual passes, in-park food, beverage and merchandise sales; service fees: lodging, up-charge experiences, parking and events; other: sponsorship and licensing arrangements

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs theme parks, water parks and aquariums, serving consumers directly; brand owner: owns park brands and animal entertainment content marketed to visitors

geography_served.value: US national: Parks in Florida, Texas, California, Virginia, Pennsylvania and other US states, visitors from US and abroad

specialization.value: related lines: marine zoological parks, theme parks, water parks and Sesame Place parks, all themed leisure attractions

distribution_channels.value: own locations: gate ticket sales and in-park food and retail outlets; online: website and app ticket and pass sales; partners / resellers: travel agencies, third-party ticket sellers and group sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: ride safety rules, animal welfare laws (USDA, Animal Welfare Act), marine mammal rules and environmental regulations
